svg.title: For fixed data and target ̄e, ̄q, deploy only while c Wh+B ≤ ̄e bCh and bCh−u−δprep−δS −2ν(n+1+a) ≥ ̄q for both labels. The smaller of the two resulting gap bounds is an explicit expiry time. A negative gap means stop or take new probes, not extrapolate stability. At a predetermined terminal sample size the fixed-time width is u(n) = A/√n, A = p
